subject: Math
prompt: A linear function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = 7x - 4$. If $g(x) = f(x + 1) - f(x - 1)$, what is the value of $g(5)$?
explanation: To find $g(5)$, substitute $5$ for $x$ in $g(x) = f(x+1) - f(x-1)$ to get $g(5) = f(6) - f(4)$. Evaluating $f(6) = 7(6) - 4 = 38$ and $f(4) = 7(4) - 4 = 24$, the difference is $38 - 24 = 14$.
